title: 10 Places that Make Leander A Perfect Place to Live
body_markdown:
From coffee dates and local bites to afternoons outdoors, Leander offers plenty of ways to fill your free time. Whether you’re exploring a new neighborhood or planning your next weekend outing, these ten spots in and around Leander are a great place to start.


## 1. Lakewood Park:


Make a day of it at Lakewood Park, where trails, a fishing pier, a playground, and a seasonal splash pad offer plenty of ways to enjoy the outdoors. Bring your pup along for a visit to the dog park, or gather friends for a game on the basketball or volleyball courts.


## 2. Casa Costa Bake Shop:


Add a little sweetness to your day at Casa Costa Bake Shop, a family-owned bakery tucked inside a remodeled 1930 home in Old Town Leander. Enjoy coffee and homemade treats inspired by the family’s Portuguese, Brazilian, and American roots.


## 3. Conejos Tex-Mex Cantina:


Bring your appetite to Conejos Tex-Mex Cantina for a menu filled with favorites like fajitas, enchiladas, and street tacos. Start with queso or guacamole to share, then save room for cinnamon-sugar churros to finish on a sweet note.


## 4. Wildfire Park:


Explore Old Town Leander’s local flavor at Wildfire Park, a gathering spot featuring food trucks, coffee, and artisan shopping. Visit during the Saturday farmers market to browse fresh produce, baked goods, and handcrafted finds from local vendors.


## 5. Perky Beans Coffee & PB Café:


Fuel your day with a handcrafted coffee at Perky Beans, or settle in next door at PB Café for a meal from its scratch kitchen. With breakfast, brunch, lunch, and dinner on the café menu, it’s an easy addition to your day’s plans.


## 6. The Fieldhouse at the Crossover:


Turn an ordinary outing into a little friendly competition at The Fieldhouse at the Crossover, where pickleball, sand volleyball, and arcade games keep the fun going. Stick around for live music or catch your favorite team on the TVs at the indoor and outdoor sports bar.


## 7. Crystal Falls Golf Club:


Enjoy a round with a view at Crystal Falls Golf Club, an 18-hole municipal course set amid the Texas Hill Country. Its scenic setting and challenging water hazards make it a great excuse to spend a few hours outdoors working on your game.


## 8. Obsidian Brewery:


Meet up with friends at Obsidian Brewery for craft beer and wood-fired pizza right here in Leander. Pair your pint with a pizza to share for an easygoing lunch or dinner out.


## 9. Devine Lake Park:


Slow down and enjoy some fresh air at Devine Lake Park, where trails, picnic areas, and a fishing lake invite you to take your time. Pack a picnic, bring your fishing gear, or let the kids explore the playground for a relaxed afternoon outdoors.


## 10. H-E-B Center at Cedar Park:


Head to nearby Cedar Park for a night out at H-E-B Center, which hosts concerts, family shows, and sporting events. Cheer on the Texas Stars hockey team or Austin Spurs basketball team, or check the event calendar for your next live entertainment outing.
